svg.title: LSM compaction merge step — connected fleet telemetry example
svg.desc: Three input SSTables hold the latest known state per vehicle property. A k-way merge keeps the newest version by event timestamp, handles backdated uploads from vehicles that were offline, and drops decommissioned vehicles. The output is the materialized device shadow that applications query.
svg.text: key = vehicle:property · seq# rises with each ingested packet
newest seq# wins; tombstones drop retired devices
